<thought>Chlorine shows a characteristic M and M+2 pattern: the base peak at m/z 183 and a strong M+2 peak at m/z 185 with ~1:3 intensity ratio, matching the natural 35Cl/37Cl isotopic abundances. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern that can be confirmed definitively from the data. Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
